submitted_root_cause: Frontend pods are failing health checks due to timeout errors, with liveness and readiness probes timing out when trying to reach the /_healthz endpoint. One pod is not ready and the service has anomalous behavior. There are also environment configuration issues with the CART_SERVICE_ADDR pointing to port 1 instead of the correct port 7070.
submitted_action: Patch the CART_SERVICE_ADDR environment variable from 'cartservice:1' to 'cartservice:7070' to fix the service connectivity issue
